mentions.name: APIKulture
mentions.description: A native desktop API client built with C++ and wxWidgets as an alternative to Postman, Insomnia, and Bruno. It remembers JSONPath expressions between requests, is lightweight at about 40MB of RAM (versus ~400MB for the alternatives), and is designed to be fast. The author uses it daily.
mentions.problem: Postman and Insomnia became forced-corporate-cloud and unusable for the author, and Bruno lacked the JSONPath expression persistence between requests that the author considered fundamental to their workflow.
mentions.source_excerpt:
APIKulture. An alternative to Postman/Insomnia/Bruno.

To be honest, I started this because Postman and Insomnia became forced-corporate-cloud not usable for me anymore, and Bruno lacked a feature I considered fundamental for my workflow.

The feature is to remember the JSONPath expressions between requests, a feature that Bruno has implemented already.

But I created this thing and I'm using it daily since then. C++ and wxWidgets, it uses 40MB of RAM, and it is super fast, instead of the 400MB used by the above mentioned programs.
mentions.author: Shorel
